items.description: # Flick the World 2019 Flick the World 2019 is a weekend full of action, discourse and fun. DIY, hacking (electronics, bio- and general), art, science, sustainability, community to society. The gathering is open to everyone interested in these topics. It is brought to you by Dock18 (Institut für Medienkulturen der Welt) https://www.dock18.ch and SGMK (Swiss Mechatronic Art Society) https://mechatronicart.ch with contributions by individuals and groups from their respective networks.
